about: T3 plan P-13: the one stub script the lane B harness replays. args = today's workflow args. enumerate = the stub enumerate output per case file. verdicts = the stub runner's verdict per case ID (R-909 has none on purpose: it is dispatched and must come back not-run). refutations = the scripted refuter votes per failing ID, in call order k = 1, 2. Coverage: pass, fail, blocked, not-run, manual; confirmed (R-908), disputed (R-906), dismissed (R-907), unadjudicated (R-905, the 4th failure under maxAdjudicated 3); a yes case whose steps hold `npx vitest run x.test.js` (R-901); a separable partly case (R-902); a grandfathered partly case (R-903); a pair sharing one identical step line in one runner prompt (R-907, R-908); an exclusive case (R-905). Two enumerate batches (60000 + 60000 > 100000) and three runner batches (cases:1, cases:2, cases:exclusive).

docs/regression/alpha.md.summary: A rewritten bullet keeps its metric
docs/regression/alpha.md.steps:
1. Run `npx vitest run lib/resume/bulletRewrite.test.js` and quote the Tests line.
2. Manual (`automatable: no`): open /tailor, paste a job description and confirm the rewritten bullet reads naturally to a recruiter.
3. Run `npx eslint lib/resume/bulletRewrite.js` and quote its summary.
docs/regression/alpha.md.expected: Both commands report zero failures; the rewritten bullet keeps the original 30% figure.
